name: gerudo_fortress
label: Gerudo's Fortress
about: Pieces and textures cut from Gerudo's Fortress (spot12). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where the fortress draws them). `ground` is the sandy floor round the fortress (dirt footsteps), `sand` the rippled dunes outside the wall in the west, `cliff` the rock walls, `sandstone` the striated canyon walls and slopes (its stripes run along v, so the scene turns it sideways). The fortress is `fortress_wall` (windows) under `stone` tops, its doors `doorway` (brick fading to black) over `doorway_floor`/`doorway_sand`; the lookout on top is `stone_dark` (`_b`). `brick` (`_b`, `_c`) are the perimeter walls, `stone_brick` the gate towers, `beam` the gate's crossbeam. In the horseback archery range: `post_wood`, the `target` rings, `platform_top`/`platform_side` (the hexagonal stands), `canopy` (the awning) and `fence`; `dust` (`_b`) is the translucent haze over its track. `backdrop_rock` is a cut-out rock card far in the west.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: gf_fortress
pieces.label: Gerudo's Fortress
pieces.about: The fortress's stacked blocks, as one building: its 13 doorways (exits 2 to 12 and 14 into the fortress's corridors, ENTR_GERUDOWAY_*; exit 15 into the Gerudo Training Ground, ENTR_MEN_0) keep their exit floors, and the vines on its east face are climbable. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: gf_lookout
pieces.label: Fortress lookout
pieces.about: The dark stone lookout high on the fortress's north-west corner: a pillar under a wider top with a railed balcony and a plank floor. Its passage east into the cliff (exit 13) is left out. Locked.

pieces.name: gf_gate
pieces.label: Gate towers
pieces.about: The two towers either side of the gate to the Haunted Wasteland, joined by a beam; the east tower has a ladder (wall types: ladder, ladder top) up to its railed top. The gate itself is an actor (Bg_Spot12_Gate), so the opening is empty. Locked.

pieces.name: gf_wall
pieces.label: Fortress wall
pieces.about: A stretch of the brick wall round the fortress's sandy west side, 400 tall, with a bend.

pieces.name: gf_stairs
pieces.label: Stone stairs
pieces.about: The stairs up from the lower yard to the fortress's courtyard (283 high over 241): a ramp drawn with steps, colliding as stone. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: gf_banner
pieces.label: Gerudo banner
pieces.about: A Gerudo emblem hanging from a rope, as over the fortress's doorways. No collision.

pieces.name: gf_archery_target
pieces.label: Archery target
pieces.about: The largest of the three targets beside the horseback archery track: a wooden ring on two legs, 454 tall.

pieces.name: gf_target_stand
pieces.label: Target platform
pieces.about: The hexagonal stand at the archery track's south end, with a target on a pole.

pieces.name: gf_canopy
pieces.label: Canopy
pieces.about: The cloth awning on four posts by the archery track's start, 130 tall.
